title: Pakistan General Election Held
detail: Pakistan held its first general election under universal adult franchise.

title: Awami League Wins Majority
detail: Sheikh Mujibur Rahman's Awami League won 167 of 169 East Pakistan seats, but power transfer was blocked, triggering a deep political crisis.

title: National Assembly Session Cancelled
detail: Yahya Khan postponed the National Assembly session, sparking mass protests across East Pakistan.

title: Bangladesh Flag Raised at Dhaka University
detail: The Bangladesh flag was raised publicly at Dhaka University, becoming a powerful symbol of resistance.

title: Historic 7 March Speech
detail: Sheikh Mujibur Rahman delivered his landmark speech, calling for struggle and national mobilization.

title: Chittagong Port Workers Resist
detail: Dock workers refused to unload military cargo, marking early organized civilian resistance.

title: Failed Talks Between Yahya and Mujib
detail: Negotiations continued in Dhaka but ended without a political settlement.

title: Jaydevpur Clash
detail: Armed confrontation between the Pakistan army and civilians intensified tensions before the crackdown.

title: Operation Searchlight Launched
detail: The Pakistan army began a coordinated military crackdown in Dhaka and other centers, leading to mass killings.

title: Declaration of Independence and Mujib's Arrest
detail: Bangladesh's independence was declared and Sheikh Mujibur Rahman was arrested by Pakistani forces.

title: Radio Declaration by Ziaur Rahman
detail: A declaration was broadcast over radio, reinforcing the independence call.

title: Renewed Declaration on Behalf of Mujib
detail: The independence declaration was repeated publicly in Mujib's name to consolidate resistance.

title: Battle of Kushtia
detail: Early armed resistance expanded, including intense fighting in Kushtia.

title: Provisional Government Formed
detail: Bangladesh's provisional government structure was formally declared.

title: Mujibnagar Government Oath
detail: The provisional government took oath at Mujibnagar, organizing the war effort under formal leadership.

title: Organized Liberation War Phase
detail: Mukti Bahini guerrilla operations expanded under sector-based command, while millions of civilians fled to India.

title: Indo-Pak War Begins
detail: Pakistan's attack on India opened full-scale conventional war, accelerating the final phase.

title: Joint Forces Advance
detail: Bangladesh and Indian joint forces advanced rapidly across multiple fronts.

title: Intellectual Killings
detail: Targeted abductions and killings of intellectuals were carried out in the closing days of the war.

title: Victory and Surrender
detail: Pakistani forces surrendered in Dhaka and Bangladesh emerged as an independent state.

title: Sheikh Mujibur Rahman Returns
detail: Sheikh Mujibur Rahman returned to independent Bangladesh.

title: Mujib Becomes Prime Minister
detail: A new state structure began to consolidate under civilian leadership.

title: Rebuilding and Recognition Phase
detail: Post-war reconstruction deepened and international recognition efforts accelerated.
